series_short_description: Pulled barefoot from their tiny studio bed into Vaeloria, Nolan (24) and Gwen (19) journey toward home.
series_description: Two days before his kid sister Gwen turned eighteen, twenty-three-year-old Nolan Lennox (5'7") broke free in tears at the Norfolk Pathfinder bus terminal—backed up by fellow passengers after his abusive girlfriend from the trailer at 2710 Ike Street slapped him for refusing a one-way cross-country bus ticket so he could go home to Emerald Creek in Chesapeake for Gwen's birthday. Dying Grandpa Walter held on to see Gwen turn eighteen—where Nolan invited an overjoyed Gwen to come live with him—before passing away the very next morning, leaving Nolan to shoulder probate, funeral paperwork, selling Grandpa's mortgaged house, and moving six-foot-one Gwen into his tiny rectangular one-person Studio 2B with one corner full-sized bed, a swiveled rabbit-ear TV and VCR/DVD combo, a dorm fridge, a microwave pantry cart, and laptops running Quantum OS 2000 Professional. A year later, an amber rift pulls barefoot Nolan (24), Gwen (19), Grandpa's plaid blanket, and all four Lofstrand forearm crutches into twin-moon Vaeloria to heal The Great Drift and earn their glowing-archway home forever.
author: Michael Ragsdale
